# Apps

The commands `mt help` lists under Apps. More in [Apps](../../../concepts/apps.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`app-attach`](#app-attach) | Attach to an app run and follow it until it ends (exits 1 if it ends in Error or is Killed) |
| [`app-delete`](#app-delete) | Delete an app (refused while it has live runs or an automation starts it) |
| [`app-get`](#app-get) | Show an app by name: its latest version, number of inputs and id |
| [`app-list`](#app-list) | List the apps in a namespace (every namespace when none is set) |
| [`app-patch-inputs`](#app-patch-inputs) | Change input values of a live app run, as `--input-<name>` (the app reads them the next time it asks) |
| [`app-ps`](#app-ps) | List the live app runs in a namespace, oldest first |
| [`app-run`](#app-run) | Run an app and wait for it to end; inputs as `--input-<name>` (exits 1 if the run ends in Error or is Killed) |
| [`app-start`](#app-start) | Start an app without waiting for the run to end; inputs as `--input-<name>` |

## app-attach

Attach to an app run and follow it until it ends (exits 1 if it ends in Error or is Killed).

```text
mt app-attach <id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The app run's id |

## app-delete

Delete an app (refused while it has live runs or an automation starts it).

```text
mt app-delete [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text |  |  | Name of the app, or name@namespace (or give `--id` instead) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--id, -i <id>` | id |  |  | The app's id, instead of its name |
| `--confirm` | flag |  |  | Delete it; without this the command only shows what would be deleted |

## app-get

Show an app by name: its latest version, number of inputs and id.

```text
mt app-get <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the app |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## app-list

List the apps in a namespace (every namespace when none is set).

```text
mt app-list [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## app-patch-inputs

Change input values of a live app run, as `--input-<name>` (the app reads them the next time it asks).

```text
mt app-patch-inputs <id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The app run's id |

Note: the run's inputs are passed as `--input-<name>`, and only the ones given change. For an input called 'User ID', pass `--input-user-id` &lt;value>.

## app-ps

List the live app runs in a namespace, oldest first.

```text
mt app-ps [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## app-run

Run an app and wait for it to end; inputs as `--input-<name>` (exits 1 if the run ends in Error or is Killed).

```text
mt app-run <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the app to run |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--web-download-partition <value>` | text |  |  | A temporary knowledge base, by id or name, to keep the web pages the agents read (default: the namespace's, else the tenant's) |

Note: an app's inputs are passed as `--input-<name>`, and every one must be given. For an input called 'User ID', pass `--input-user-id` &lt;value>.

## app-start

Start an app without waiting for the run to end; inputs as `--input-<name>`.

```text
mt app-start <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the app to start |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--web-download-partition <value>` | text |  |  | A temporary knowledge base, by id or name, to keep the web pages the agents read (default: the namespace's, else the tenant's) |

Note: an app's inputs are passed as `--input-<name>`, and every one must be given. For an input called 'User ID', pass `--input-user-id` &lt;value>.
